events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Alexander Nikishin scored 41 seconds into overtime to give the Eastern Conference-leading Carolina Hurricanes a 4-3 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikishin scores in OT to lift the East-leading Hurricanes past the Maple Leafs, 4-3

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Logan Thompson made 30 saves, losing his shutout bid with just 43 seconds remaining, and the Washington Capitals beat the New Jersey Devils 2-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Logan Thompson backstops Capitals to 2-1 win over the Devils

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon had three assists in Colorado's 4-1 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks on Friday night, helping the Avalanche become the first NHL team to clinch a playoff spot this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon stars as the Avalanche beat the Blackhawks 4-1 to clinch playoff spot

headlines.description: — Dustin Wolf made 24 saves, Victor Olofsson scored his first goal for Calgary and the Flames beat the Florida Panthers 4-1 on Friday night for their second straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dustin Wolf makes 24 saves in the Flames' 4-1 victory over the Panthers

headlines.description: — Alex Killorn broke a tie off a scramble at 9:09 of the second period, Lukas Dostal stopped 29 shots and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Utah Mammoth 4-1 on Friday night to pad their Pacific Division lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks beat the Mammoth 4-1 to pad their Pacific Division lead
